x: Bob Martin, Syd Roberts and Harry Thaxter even beat our eighth "A" team man. Altogether, we look back with profound satisfaction on this Championship Day.
Bob Martin, we regret to learn, has been in hospital with a damaged ankle. We trust that it is not serious and that he will soon be on the road again.
W.C., resulted in Colin Sutton and Bob Martin qualifying for membership of the Centurions' Club, and both are to be congratulated on their excellent performances under most adverse conditions.

Those members who knew the late Bob Martin, one of our foremost distance walkers will be pleased to hear that his daughter Sheila is following in his footsteps and on November 3rd was 2nd in the Women's 2 miles National Junior Championship at Regents Park.

In the same race was Bob Martin, a policeman who also figured in many of our teams, and who clocked 22:16:57 to become No. 127. He was killed in an accident whilst on a motor-cycle patrol a few years later.
